scope_reference_evidence.text_excerpt: This PCR covers cradle-to-factory-gate manufacture of complete assembled floor-standing, non-electrical steel multi-drawer office filing cabinets for paper-document storage. The bounded reference route uses supplied uncoated cold-rolled steel sheet, actual forming/joining, documented cleaning/conversion pretreatment, whole purchased thermosetting powder coating and thermal cure, complete hardware assembly and the unique first quality release. Supplier-prefabricated parts keep their complete upstream route. Real subsequent factory storage, packaging, handling, dispatch and all actual rework, including unauthorized, failed or rejected work are linked incremental services for the original release cohort and declared horizon.

This is a qualitative technical synthesis: the manufacturer route, an independent complete-cabinet market example and historical construction/test specification establish different parts of the method. They do not describe the same SKU, factory or order. No source example is a universal recipe or quantity. In particular, the historical liquid-enamel route and the manufacturer knock-down/door-cabinet variants are adjacent counterexamples, not evidence that this assembled powder-coated terminal is a parts kit.

Exclude chair frames/seating, loose sheet, single drawers/slides/doors, generic metal-furniture bundles, kitchen cabinets, electrical/instrument enclosures, fire/explosion/security-certified safes, special certified products, upholstery, installation, distribution beyond the declared factory gate, use, maintenance in use and end-of-life of the sold cabinet. No special certification or life is implied.

en_description.text_excerpt: The sole reference output is the unique newly quality-released complete assembled cabinet configuration; Q includes all its accepted drawers, slide assemblies, lock, actual handles/feet/interlock and cured finish, excluding files, test weights, removable packaging and unaccepted/released-again items. en.text_excerpt: | boundary_packaging | all inventory rows | For each separate packaging material/SKU reconcile opening empty plus attached WIP/FG plus reusable stock + P + I + ER + X_in = closing full corresponding stock + gross S + EO + W + X_out. Each P/I/ER/S/EO/W card is one actual direction/event and uses its complete gross V numerator. P/I ownership is counted once; supplier-included ingress retains its physical material and one upstream owner. Internal reuse cancels and is neither a new purchase nor product Q. These legs and repair/water X_in/X_out are de-duplicated only against an OTHER same-event flow on the SAME side (inflow against inflow, outflow against outflow), never against stocks, the opposite side or mere card existence: actual influx remains when new material/water is in closing stock, alongside full closing wet mass. Never stock-correct or economically scale a physical gross card. Weigh each whole wet article once; record its dry substrate, adhesive, liner, metal and retained water as nonadditive composition subaccounts. Separately added onsite components are disjoint exchanges or are explicitly bridged into the whole article without a second input/provider. Natural moisture up

zh.text_excerpt: | boundary_packaging | all inventory rows | 逐种独立包材/SKU闭合：期初空包装加附着在制品/成品及周转库存 + P + I + ER + X_in = 对应完整期末库存 + 毛S + EO + W + X_out。每项P/I/ER/S/EO/W卡仅代表一个真实方向/事件，以完整毛V为分子。P/I采购归属仅计一次；供方随货入厂包装保留实物和一次上游归属。内部周转抵消，既不是新购也不是产品Q。六腿及维修/水X_in/X_out只与同一事件同一侧的其他流项去重（入对入、出对出），绝不与库存、对侧流或仅因有卡而去重；新增料/水留期末库存时仍保留真实入流及完整期末湿质量。实物毛卡不得库存校正或按经济份额缩量。整件湿包装仅称量一次；干基材、胶、衬层、金属与保留水分作为不相加的组成子账。现场另加组分应为互斥交换，或明确桥接进入整件，不能再计一次投入/供方。自然吸湿、干燥和环境湿气穿流作为真实实物事件记录，不虚构为维修用水。对一次真实混合废物出口，分别实测各来源包材W：或者一个混合总量附不相加来源子账，或者总和等于该总量的互斥来源交换；真实处理供方仅计一次。不得把两种表示相加为重复产出。实际出现而未列出的物种、水相、组分、退回状态或混合出口，必须先增补兼容原子卡、规程与供方边界，工厂数据集方可完整；未知不是零。 | `pulage-cabinet-manufacture-2025`; `jrc-ilcd-allocation-2010` |

findings.summary: The defined exhaustive P/I/ER receipt partition omits a first standalone non-purchased packaging article.
findings.counterexample: Opening stock=0. Receive a first standalone gift/borrow/pool whole packaging article compatible with this actual pool (20 kg measured wet lot), with no paid-goods acquisition, no supplier-accompanied material and no earlier outward event. Retain all 20 kg at closing; no additions/removals, shipment or waste. Old P=I=ER=0 gives left side 0, right side 20 kg. It cannot be invented as an old return or repaired by a moisture/repair residual.
findings.expected_repair: Make actual paid whole-article receipts P (including proven bundled paid goods); make I a disjoint actual first non-purchased receipt, explicitly including borrowed/gift/pool and supplier-included cases that are not P; ER needs the same article earlier outward history. Update headings/cards/protocol fields and normative rules in both languages. Preserve full gross mass, wet stocks, original cohort/H, inherited service and one actual burden owner; no fresh manufacture burden solely because ownership changes.

frozen_source_independent_review.heat_review: No definitive equal-supply/return-mass error identified in bounded inspected thermal rules/cards. Where present, carrier mass, actual thermal states and supplier ownership are separate. Routes excluding heat require expansion before actual use. This is not empirical heat-meter verification.
